findings.message: `fail_on_reject` defaults to `False`, so the new behaviour becomes the default: a rejected review that today raises `HITLRejectException` and leaves downstream tasks `upstream_failed` will silently start skipping them instead. Default it to `True` so existing DAGs keep the documented behaviour and the skip is opt-in, or emit a deprecation warning for one release before flipping the default.

`task`, `ti` and `ctx` are bare `MagicMock()`s standing in for the task, TaskInstance and Context that `execute_complete` reads. Spec them (`MagicMock(spec=BaseOperator)` / `create_autospec`, and `spec=TaskInstance` for `ti`) so this test fails if `get_direct_relatives` or `is_teardown` stops existing on the real objects instead of fabricating them.
